message.content: {"note_claim": "NASA Administrator Isaacman participates in airshows with his F-5 aircraft as part of NASA's outreach mission.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Visitors will see an F-5 and a MiG-29 piloted by NASA's 15th administrator, Jared Isaacman, alongside other F-5s.", "reason": "The page confirms Isaacman pilots an F-5 at the airshow and that NASA participates for inspiration, but does not mention that he personally covers costs or reference a 'Flight Inspiration Program.'"}

parsed.note_claim: NASA Administrator Isaacman participates in airshows with his F-5 aircraft as part of NASA's outreach mission.
